title: Finch Circle Member Lining Discount — Marlowe & Finch Alterations Benefit Grid
content:
A member lining discount applies to the lined surcharge for added work on a Marlowe & Finch Alterations ticket when the ticket names the customer's own Marlowe & Finch purchase record. The discount follows the customer's tier in the Finch Circle Loyalty Program.

| Ticket names the customer's own purchase record | Customer | Member lining discount |
|---|---|---|
| yes | active member at Finch Circle Platinum or above (a tier whose qualifying spend threshold is 2500.00 USD or more) | 10 percent |
| yes | active Finch Circle Silver or Gold member (a tier whose qualifying spend threshold is 500.00 USD or more and below 2500.00 USD) | 5 percent |
| yes | anyone else | none |
| no | any | none |

**Records read.** The purchase record named on the ticket and whose it is; the tier and status of the customer's Finch Circle membership.

## Grid read across

| Membership | Own purchase named | No purchase named |
|---|---|---|
| Platinum or above, active | 10 percent | none |
| Silver or Gold, active | 5 percent | none |
| Finch Circle Member tier, active | none | none |
| No active membership | none | none |

## Hypothetical illustration

An active Gold member brings in a lined jacket bought at Marlowe & Finch, and the ticket names that purchase: 5 percent. The same member bringing in a jacket bought elsewhere, with no purchase named: none.
